description: Cost-alarm thresholds + cool-down config. Read by CostAlarmEngine.check() on each tick. Edit defaults inline; per-task-class overrides under taskClassOverrides.

_doc.thresholds: USD or token caps; an alarm fires when daily OR weekly EITHER USD or tokens crosses its cap.
_doc.coolDownMinutes: After an alarm fires for a given alarm key, suppress repeats for this many minutes.
_doc.channels: Where alarms get written. JSONL is canonical; agent_chat is human-visible.
_doc.rotation: When alarmLogMaxBytes is exceeded, rotate to .1, .2, ... up to alarmLogKeepArchives.
_doc.taskClassOverrides: Per-task-class threshold map. Lookup by taskClass string; falls through to top-level thresholds when absent.
_doc.tentacleAllowList: null = aggregate all tentacles. Array = only these tentacles count toward thresholds.
_doc.ignoreTestTentacles: Skip records whose tentacle starts with any testTentaclePrefixes entry.
